policy.source_unit: Pinned source C file; duplicate bodies retained as distinct source lineages. Report semantic duplicates separately.
policy.negative: Wrong specification holds implementation fixed; wrong implementation holds correct specification fixed.
policy.correctness: Positive requires CN verify success and QCP automatic plus checked manual proofs. Negative requires a semantic witness, no parse/tool failure credit.
policy.scope: Function coverage explicit per source; no claim of whole-program coverage.
policy.trusted: No trusted annotation permitted on mutation targets.
policy.status: Missing files are pending, never counted as generated or verified.
